name: Architecture · transition, cloud to cloud
purpose: The shared transition treatment for moving services between clouds or regions: the same rows in Cloud A and Cloud B with state encoding only changing, dual-running and canary routes between them, a weighted DNS and traffic manager on top, wave badges and the legend.
